text: The indexer now calls ParseAFolderLine while four parsing stages become protected in nsParseMailMessageState. The fixed indexer still documents its deliberate choice to continue after a parser result, and treats oversized incomplete lines separately. This supports the exact interface boundary and this caller tolerance; it does not support ignoring every parser failure. No malformed-line or indexing runtime test ran.
title: Use the public parser wrapper when internal stages become protected
